ramm_curator.text: Welcome to RAMM, the Royal Albert Memorial Museum, opened in 1868. Everyone comes to see Gerald.
Gerald is our giraffe. Stuffed, a very long time ago, and very much loved. Every child in Exeter has had a photo taken with Gerald's knees.
We've Roman finds from Isca too: coins, pots, and the bathhouse they dug up beside the cathedral. Exeter's always been somewhere to be.
